tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled mechanism support a coupled memory ODE, but five paid rows are insufficient to identify its four parameters reliably. Acquire the additional trajectory batch before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows leave the four coupled parameters insufficiently constrained; the verified mechanism note calls for at least eight.
The fine trajectory batch directly addresses parameter identifiability for the recalled memory ODE.
These uncoupled alternatives do not account for the observed history gap and coupled transient lag.
It is not relevant to identifying the stated mechanism.
